728-826-1636-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
728-826-1636-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

3257-4913-5310-7857.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

500-2523-2557-7824.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Bard and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Bard token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Bards dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Bard that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Bards you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

4050-5189-5439-7824.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4050-5189-5439-7824.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2350-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5060-7147-7654.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
2034-4871-5060-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Repeat.

2438-5170-6132-6772.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

5795-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4364-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-6911.description:
Declare Aurelia as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Aurelia that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Aurelia and the Aurelia token as attackers.
The Aurelia token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-5073-5220-5708.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

573-1479-5361.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1025-5529.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis and Generous Plunderer's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Generous Plunderer trigger, causing you to create a Treasure token and causing an opponent to create a tapped Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Repeat during each of your turns.
As long as Stasis is on the battlefield, players skip their untap steps.

413-1020-2866-3003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
413-1020-2866-3003.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
 Repeat.

147-2034-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2034-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

283-2113-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Karametra's Favor attached to Soliton.
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
283-2113-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Soliton's ability.
Resolve the copy of Soliton's ability, untapping it.
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
 Resolve Soliton's ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

1399-2681-3300-3814.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
1399-2681-3300-3814.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {G}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {B}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Cast The Meathook Massacre by paying {1}{B}{B}.
When The Meathook Massacre enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, giving each creature -1/-1 until end of turn.
All Spirit tokens your opponents control die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
The Meathook Massacre's third ability triggers for each Spirit that dies this way, causing you to gain that much life.

1308-1563-1867-2206-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Food tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

841-4050-4488-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4050-4488-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Beast token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

914-2034-2232-2532.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis has haste or does not have summoning sickness.
Your opponents control at least two artifacts or enchantments.
914-2034-2232-2532.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, discarding a card, and tapping it, creating a copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste and "When this creature dies, draw a card".
Dockside Extortionist and Cloudstone Curio each trigger.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger, returning Jaxis to your hand.
Resolve Dockside Extortionist's trigger, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Tap and sacrifice two Treasure tokens to add {R}{R}.
Sacrifice the Dockside Extortionist token to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
The Dockside Extortionist token's ability from step 1 triggers, drawing a card.
Pay {1}{R} to cast and resolve Jaxis for its Blitz cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2178-3337-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
You control another nonlegendary creature.
2178-3337-4050.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of any other nonlegendary creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

914-1792-2617.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1792-2617.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Midnight Guard.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Midnight Guard.
Activate Midnight Guard by tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Midnight Guard.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 7.
